builder_plan.scenario: Start with one repeated product task that has a measurable failure or cost.
builder_plan.change: Read the methods and identify one change you can isolate in that workflow.
builder_plan.baseline: Your current implementation on the same held-out tasks.
steps: Locate the paper's implementation and check its license, model support, data needs, and hardware requirements. Stop here if you cannot obtain the required artifacts.
Save a small set of representative product tasks and expected outcomes. Keep evaluation tasks out of any training or tuning, and choose quality and cost limits before running.
Run the baseline and the proposed change on identical inputs. Keep other settings fixed and repeat paired runs to expose variation.
Save per-task outputs, failures, timings, and all usage costs. Review regressions before expanding the test.
builder_plan.measure: Successful outcomes, response time, human rework, and total cost per successful task.
builder_plan.decision: Keep the change only if it meets your preselected quality and latency limits and improves the metric you care about after setup and operating costs. Otherwise retain the baseline. This is an exploration plan, not a validated recommendation.

title: Tri-Stack-PIM: A Heterogeneous Multi-Die 3D-Integrated Processing-in-Memory Architecture for Efficient LLM Inference
summary: The method replaces off-chip DRAM access and host-offloaded nonlinear operations in GPU-based decoding with a three-die stack separating DRAM storage, mature-node PHY/DMA/near-memory logic, and an advanced-node SIMD MAC die, coordinated by a hardware out-of-order scheduler. It costs custom 3D-integrated silicon with hybrid bonding, a dedicated micro-operation scheduler, and architecture-dataflow co-design effort, none of which is purchasable or deployable on existing hardware. It can fail commercially because the results are architectural evaluations rather than measurements of a manufactured part, so yield, thermal, and cost feasibility at production scale remain unvalidated.
rationale: This is a hardware architecture proposal requiring fabrication of a custom 3D-stacked PIM chip, which a team with one 24 GB GPU or API access cannot adopt or test, so it is only worth monitoring for future commercial accelerators.

claims.statement: The method replaces off-chip DRAM access and host-offloaded nonlinear operations in GPU-based decoding with a three-die stack separating DRAM storage, mature-node PHY/DMA/near-memory logic, and an advanced-node SIMD MAC die, coordinated by a hardware out-of-order scheduler. It costs custom 3D-integrated silicon with hybrid bonding, a dedicated micro-operation scheduler, and architecture-dataflow co-design effort, none of which is purchasable or deployable on existing hardware. It can fail commercially because the results are architectural evaluations rather than measurements of a manufactured part, so yield, thermal, and cost feasibility at production scale remain unvalidated.

Geometric-mean speedups of 4.95x, 2.57x, and 1.68x over GPU, AttAcc, and H2-LLM baselines respectively across MHA/GQA/MQA attention and batch sizes 1-32; co-explored configurations reduce energy-delay product by 33-66x over naive parameter selection.
